name: Verify Pre-Joining Compliance Documents
description: Verify PAN, Aadhaar, educational transcripts, and previous employment proofs.

name: Initiate Background Verification (BGV)
description: Hand over verified documents to external BGV agency.

name: Provision Developer Workstation & Cloud Credentials
description: Allocate laptop, GitHub, AWS/GCP IAM accounts, and VPN access.

name: Conduct Day-1 Buddy Introduction
description: Meet new joinee and introduce codebase, engineering guidelines, and squad.

name: Complete Corporate Induction & Security Training
description: Attend corporate culture and infosec training modules.

name: Group Health Insurance & PF Enrollment
description: Enroll employee in medical insurance and complete EPFO UAN registration.

name: Define 90-Day Probation Objectives & KPIs
description: Collaboratively document technical deliverables and milestones for probation period.

name: Conduct Day-30 Probation Check-in
description: Review first-month integration, squad feedback, and ramp-up pace.

name: Conduct Day-60 Mid-Probation Review
description: Evaluate sprint contributions and highlight any performance blockers.

name: Conduct Final Day-90 Probation Assessment
description: Formal decision to recommend confirmation or initiate extension.

name: Probation Extension Plan Review & Reassessment
description: Audit improvement roadmap and milestone achievement for extended probation.

name: HR Review of Probation Assessment
description: Audit probation signoffs, attendance, and compliance requirements.

name: Generate & Dispatch Confirmation Letter
description: Generate signed confirmation letter and update employment master records.

name: Complete Bi-Annual Self-Appraisal
description: Summarize cycle technical contributions, project impact, and self-ratings.

name: Complete Manager Performance Evaluation
description: Rate engineer across technical excellence, delivery velocity, and collaboration.

name: Department Calibration & Rating Finalization
description: Normalize team ratings across department delivery benchmarks.

name: Annual OKR & Goals Alignment Review
description: Define key results and strategic objectives for the upcoming performance cycle.

name: Formal Resignation Acceptance & Notice Calculation
description: Acknowledge resignation notice, determine official last working day.

name: HR Separation Exit Interview
description: Conduct formal exit interview regarding departure reasons and feedback.

name: Complete Technical Knowledge Transfer (KT)
description: Document repositories, transfer system ownership, and handover open sprints.

name: Retrieve IT Hardware & Revoke Cloud Credentials
description: Collect company laptop, access cards, and de-provision cloud SSO access.

name: Process Finance & Full and Final (F&F) Settlement Clearance
description: Verify expense claims, notice period recovery, and signoff final dues.

name: Issue Service Certificate & Relieving Letter
description: Generate and email digitally signed relieving documentation.

name: Annual Conflict of Interest & Security Declaration
description: Complete mandatory corporate governance and ethical standard declarations.

name: Periodic Identity & Statutory Records Audit
description: Audit tax, Aadhaar, and professional credentials against regulatory mandates.
